name: folium-vendor-highlightjs
//: This manifest exists so Dependabot / GitHub's dependency graph track version bumps and security advisories for highlight.js, even though nothing here actually runs as JS. Sources/Folium's real vendored files (gitignored, regenerated by scripts/vendor-highlightjs.sh) are copied from @highlightjs/cdn-assets, the prebuilt-bundle package. highlight.js is listed too, pinned to the same version, purely because GitHub Security Advisories may be filed against the 'highlight.js' package name rather than '@highlightjs/cdn-assets' even though the two ship in lockstep and the vulnerable code is identical — listing both means an advisory against either name surfaces here. Do not add it as an actual dependency of anything; it is unused.
